text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I beat Taiki at the mile, too! I didn't 
win just because I was strong. It's 
because I truly, wholly believed in my own 
potential.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And anyone can do it! I was born to spread 
that message, and that's why I achieved 
this victory!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Taiki challenged me to a 
rematch, but I have to put that on hold. 
My Trainer and I still have unfinished 
business—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, conquering a European G1! Next year, 
I'm going to meet the Pearl Family all 
over the world!
